title: Python integer division and remainder of negative numbers
summary: Integer // Round to negative infinity, non-zero remainder has the same sign as the divisor.
applies: Python 3; standard library or built-in integers
detail: -7 // 3 is -3, -7 % 3 is 2; both maintain a == (a // b) * b + a % b.
boundary: When porting a program that uses zero-truncated division, both the quotient and remainder of negative inputs may change.
relevance: Negative modulo differences across languages change table entries when restoring periodic indexes.
